_note: Español de España; see topbar.json. The right column's tool tabs (Timers, Messages, Props, Macros, Stage, Audio, VoxLive) and what they draw: cards, menus, fields, empty states, timer kinds, macro steps, stage layout items and the stage screens' NEXT label, and what saving these things says. The design's lang-tables.js rows are used where they exist (Counts down from…, Words once…, Stays until taken off, Show on stage, Stage message, Edit layouts…). Rows ending in .short are used where the usual words don't fit their room (the Props card's second line, the Stage tab's screen picker and its heading, the Audio level's Muted).
